EXAMPLE BODY · TEST DOCUMENT · NOT REAL RULES




Example Event Regulations
V.2.0 · 15.02.2026
Invented for software testing only.

1. Registration
1.1 Deadline
Teams register at least ten days before the example event.

1.2 Fighters
Each fighter is registered by name before the first bout.

2. Results
2.1 Protests
A captain may raise a protest with the head marshal within ten
minutes of the bout ending.
